answer: Consensus uses an EigenTrust-style matrix whose reciprocity-weighted transitive endorsements determine eigenvector centrality, while each reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life. Thus shale, cedar, and raven, if newly spawned as sybil identities, begin with near-zero centrality; they cannot manufacture trusted influence through self-endorsement and cannot pass consensus without sustained, independently corroborated honest service.
